sql:
SELECT event_id, event_time, class_uid, src_hostname, dst_hostname, process_name, source_ip, dest_ip, src_port, dst_port, protocol, file_path, hash_sha256, user_name, action, outcome, session_id, session_key, session_key_kind, session_originating_human, ocsf_json FROM (
 SELECT event_id, event_time, class_uid, src_hostname, dst_hostname, process_name, source_ip, dest_ip, src_port, dst_port, protocol, file_path, hash_sha256, user_name, action, outcome, session_id, session_key, session_key_kind, session_originating_human, ocsf_json, row_number() OVER (
 PARTITION BY tenant_id,event_time,class_uid,event_id ORDER BY ingest_time DESC) AS source_rank
 FROM aisoc.raw_events WHERE tenant_id=%(tenant_id)s AND src_hostname=%(hostname)s
 AND event_time>=toDateTime64(%(start)s,6,'UTC') AND event_time<toDateTime64(%(end)s,6,'UTC')
 AND class_uid=%(class_uid)s
) WHERE source_rank=1 ORDER BY event_time,event_id LIMIT %(fetch_limit)s
